context.why: Fifth story of FS-030. Accepted so far: US1 (fields location/location_elevation/location_uncertainty on Sample and Measurement via LocatedRecord, the location input with parse_coordinate in fairdm/contrib/location/forms.py), US3 (measurement's own and effective location), US2 (lookups, spatial coverage, tables), US4 (API). This story puts locations into tabular import and export (plan D10): where a sample or measurement resource's fields include 'location' (registration resource_fields/fields, built by the registry's resource factory in fairdm/registry/factories.py around generate resource, and the hand-written SampleResource/MeasurementResource in fairdm/contrib/import_export/resources.py), the location expands into four columns latitude, longitude, location_elevation and location_uncertainty. Each is an import-export Field with a widget in a new fairdm/contrib/location/resources.py. Export writes the record's OWN values in WGS 84 decimal degrees (a measurement never exports its sample's). Import reads latitude and longitude with parse_coordinate (any notation the form accepts), sets the three model fields, and a refused value is reported as that row's error with the form's message and the row is not saved. A location is never exported or imported as a table of its own. Import/export views are not routed today (roadmap R21): test at the resource level (resource.export(), resource.import_data(dataset, dry_run=...)).
prior_decisions: D1: a location is a value on each record, never a shared row. No Location model, no get_or_create.
D2: Organization holds a plain point, a Person holds none. Contributor.location is removed.
D8: no data migration — existing Point data is not carried across.
D12: field names are location, location_elevation, location_uncertainty.

FR-009: a sample type shows the location input only when its registration's fields list location. The demo's RockSample registration is to list location (as the approved prototype did); WaterSample does not.

D3 (decisions): a measurement falls back to its sample's location only for a viewer who may open the sample (Sample.objects.visible_to(user)); for anyone else a measurement with no location of its own has none.
D16: location constraints are listed in each concrete model's own Meta (location_constraints()), not on LocatedRecord.Meta.

SPEC-001 (design review): the elevation and uncertainty columns are named location_elevation and location_uncertainty so they cannot collide with a sample type's own elevation field; latitude and longitude keep their plain names.
Do not build organization forms or anything DataCite: later stories, and the DataCite story is on hold.

verified_base.note: US1, US3, US2 and US4 accepted. Full verify green on c750285d, then only spec-directory commits. The test step takes 4 to 6 minutes.

acceptance.given_when_then: Export writes latitude, longitude, location_elevation and location_uncertainty, empty for a record with none; export then import into an empty dataset gives the same locations; degrees+minutes and DMS import as decimal degrees; a row with an unreadable or out-of-range coordinate is reported with the value and not saved; a measurement row carries only its own location.
The four columns and their widgets exist in fairdm/contrib/location/resources.py and the resource factory expands location into them when the fields list location.
locations.md documents the import and export columns and the notations accepted.
